jurisdiction.name: World Intellectual Property Organization
jurisdiction.overview: Official documents of this organisation are listed on its own page and are not counted in member countries' totals.

narrative.summary: WIPO's Member States have not adopted a treaty, resolution or formal decision dedicated to AI. WIPO has run a Member State dialogue on IP and AI since 2019 (the WIPO Conversation, succeeded by a Global Forum on IP and AI from 2026) and has published an IP policy toolkit for policymakers on AI-related inventions (2024).
lead_institutions: WIPO Secretariat (IP and Frontier Technologies Division)

instruments.official_title: Getting the Innovation Ecosystem Ready for AI: An IP policy toolkit
instruments.english_title: Getting the Innovation Ecosystem Ready for AI: An IP policy toolkit
instruments.issuing_authority: World Intellectual Property Organization (IP and Frontier Technologies Division)
instruments.publisher_name: World Intellectual Property Organization (IP and Frontier Technologies Division)
instruments.summary: Toolkit for policymakers and IP offices on preparing patent systems for AI. It classifies AI innovation into AI models, AI-assisted, AI-based and AI-generated inventions, suggests actions on protection options, patentability, data access, inventive step and disclosure, and sets out policy options on inventorship for AI-generated inventions, from keeping human-only inventorship to a sui generis right, recommending multi-stakeholder consultation.
instruments.current_status: Published by WIPO in 2024 as a policy toolkit prepared by its IP and Frontier Technologies Division; the publication states that it is not intended to reflect the views of the Member States or the WIPO Secretariat.
instruments.evidence_reference: '© WIPO, 2024', WIPO Publication No. 2003EN, ISBN 978-92-805-3605-8 printed in PDF; year only. Borderline record because of the disclaimer; kept as WIPO-issued guidance to policymakers. | Independent check 2026-10-21: Title, © WIPO 2024, IP and Frontier Technologies Division, disclaimer, four invention categories, inventorship options and multi-stakeholder approach confirmed in PDF.; 'Non-binding' not stated.
